name: Can I live in my house during a home addition construction?
description: Living in your house during an addition depends on the project's scope; smaller additions might allow it, while larger ones often require temporary relocation.

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my house during a home addition construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your house during a home addition depends on the scope of the project. For smaller additions that minimally impact essential services like kitchens or bathrooms, it might be feasible, though disruptive. For larger additions, especially those involving major structural work, utility cutoffs, or extensive dust and noise, it's often safer and more comfortable to arrange temporary alternative living arrangements. We can discuss the specifics and help you plan accordingly.
